posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md: Hey, this is really interesting. Can one make a suitable ECDL grating with a hologram? Will this setup prevent mode hopping. Can I do the same with a YAG crystal?

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: Temperature stability is the first chalange. If the grating to diode distance changes then you will have mode hopping problems. I can't remember who it was, but one of our members succeded in making one 100mm long. I would get a grating from Edmund Industrial optics, a TEC from Melcor and a TEC controller and diode driver from Wavelength Electronics.

posts.author: Sergio
posts.content_md:
> **Hans:** Hey, this is really interesting. Can one make a suitable ECDL grating with a hologram? Will this setup prevent mode hopping. Can I do the same with a YAG crystal?

These lasers use an ordinary grating in Littrow configuration that isn't too expensive, better buy it. Yes, could be used, but I never saw one in YAG, in dye lasers this is very common.
